integrity: The formula is derived by symbolic algebra and an analytic worst-case boundary proof; included finite rational tests are not an infinite proof. The method and its explicit recovered-state warning are credited to the source, and prior-art coverage is qualified rather than claimed exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Proved for a single completed deterministic reduced SIR NSFD step with exact constant physical infection and recovery rates; it does not cover learned independent rates, extra compartments, rounding effects, or convergence rates.
title: A sharp simplex-invariance threshold for a reduced gain–loss SIR step
